fork.name: sunnypilot
fork.description: sunnypilot is a feature fork of comma.ai's openpilot for 300+ cars that modifies driving-assist engagement behavior while staying as close as possible to comma's safety rules. Its hallmarks are MADS (independent, always-on lane centering), Speed Limit Control, vision/map curve slowdowns, neural-network lateral control and an OTA driving-model selector, backed by its own sunnylink cloud services and extra car ports (Hyundai/Kia NON-SCC, GM NON-ACC, Toyota SecOC, Tesla Model X and more) beyond the stock supported-car list.

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Continuously steers to keep the car centered in its lane using the driving model. Core openpilot capability on every supported car.

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake for adaptive cruise instead of the car's stock ACC. Native on some cars; on many others it is available only behind an alpha toggle, and some cars always keep stock ACC.

features.name: Experimental Mode (end-to-end)
features.description: End-to-end longitudinal driving that can slow for turns, traffic lights and stop signs. Opt-in; requires openpilot longitudinal control on the car.

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: Steers through a lane change when the driver signals and nudges the wheel above the minimum lane-change speed.

features.name: Stop and Go
features.description: Follows traffic to a complete stop and resumes automatically. Some cars cannot resume from a stop or cannot engage ACC below a minimum speed.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Camera-based driver attention monitoring with escalating alerts, including an optional Always-On Driver Monitoring toggle that stays active even when sunnypilot is disengaged. sunnypilot adds steering-wheel touch enforcement under MADS.

features.name: Driving Personality
features.description: Aggressive / Standard / Relaxed following-distance profiles, switchable from the settings or the steering-wheel distance button. Only affects openpilot longitudinal control.

features.name: MADS (always-on lateral)
features.description: Modular Assistive Driving System: lets lane centering stay engaged independently of cruise control, with dedicated engage controls, Unified Engagement Mode and per-brand safety support. sunnypilot's flagship feature; on by default and customizable.

features.name: Speed Limit Control / Assist
features.description: Reads speed limits from the car and offline OSM data with selectable source policy and offset. Info and Warning modes display/chime; Assist mode adjusts the set speed and needs openpilot longitudinal or ICBM.

features.name: sunnylink Cloud Services
features.description: sunnypilot's own backend: device registration, settings backup and restore, sponsor/GitHub pairing, remote settings and OTA services. Opt-in with consent screen.

features.name: Smart Cruise Control - Vision (VTSC)
features.description: Slows the car for upcoming curves using the vision model's predicted path. Opt-in toggle; requires openpilot longitudinal control or ICBM.

features.name: Smart Cruise Control - Map (MTSC)
features.description: Slows the car for curves ahead using offline OpenStreetMap data from the mapd daemon. Opt-in toggle; requires openpilot longitudinal control or ICBM plus downloaded maps.

features.name: Dynamic Experimental Control
features.description: Automatically blends between standard ACC and end-to-end Experimental Mode based on driving context. Opt-in; requires openpilot longitudinal control.

features.name: Intelligent Cruise Button Management
features.description: Alpha feature that presses the stock cruise buttons for you, enabling speed features (SLC, VTSC, MTSC) on cars that keep stock ACC. Available for Honda, Hyundai/Kia/Genesis, Chrysler-family and Mazda.

features.name: Auto Lane Change (nudgeless)
features.description: Starts the lane change automatically a configurable delay after the turn signal, without a steering nudge, with an optional extra delay when the blind-spot monitor sees a car.

features.name: Steering Mode on Brake (MADS)
features.description: Chooses what lateral control does when you press the brake under MADS: remain active (no disengage on brake), pause until release, or disengage.

features.name: Torque Lateral Control Tuning
features.description: Enforce torque-based steering control with selectable tune versions, live self-tuning, and manual real-time lateral-accel/friction override. Torque-steering cars only.

features.name: Hyundai Custom Longitudinal Tuning
features.description: Dynamic or Predictive jerk-limited longitudinal profiles for Hyundai/Kia/Genesis (ISO 15622-based), with per-car overrides. Requires sunnypilot longitudinal (alpha).

features.name: OTA Driving Model Selector
features.description: Download and switch between multiple driving-model bundles over the air, with favorites, cache management and per-model version compatibility.

features.name: Pause Lateral with Blinker
features.description: Pauses lane centering while the turn signal is on below a set speed, with a configurable re-engage delay after the blinker stops.

features.name: Onroad UI & Device Customization
features.description: Extra onroad widgets and device options: blind-spot warnings, steering torque bar, standstill timer, green-light and lead-departure alerts, true-speed display, acceleration bar, chevron metrics, Tesla rainbow mode, screen-off brightness and timeout controls.

features.name: Developer UI Metrics
features.description: Optional overlay of detailed driving metrics (speeds, accels, controls state) at the edge of the onroad screen.

features.name: Quiet Mode
features.description: Suppresses non-critical engagement chimes and audible alerts for a quieter drive.

features.name: Neural Network Lateral Control
features.description: Torque steering controller driven by a neural feedforward model (based on twilsonco's NNFF), fetched per car fingerprint. Opt-in; torque-steering cars with a trained model only.

features.name: Offline OSM Maps (mapd)
features.description: Downloads OpenStreetMap regions to the device (based on pfeiferj's mapd) to provide speed limits, curvature and road data without a connection.

features.name: Road Name Display
features.description: Shows the current road name on the onroad screen from offline OSM data; requires a downloaded map region.
